title: Shareholder Rerating instance configuration
description: Reaches the manager as ManagerInvocation.config. These are operating constants of the instance, not the shape of the method: nothing here can loosen the Mandate, and nothing here is a threshold the case classification turns on. The thresholds that classify — the execution pace floor, the observable-elapsed share, the sector-relative yield multiple and the non-recurring share — are properties of disclosure practice and accounting materiality rather than of an investor's appetite, so they live in lib/thresholds.mjs and are not configurable. Every value here is also written into PROMPT.md, because an invocation may carry no config block at all.

deepReviewIntervalDays.description: How often a held thesis gets a full re-argument rather than a price and risk check. 30 days by default because the disclosures this methodology reads — results, dividend resolutions, treasury acquisition reports — arrive on a monthly-or-slower cadence, and a deep review that runs faster than its evidence arrives is re-reading the same filings.

maxActiveTheses.description: How many completed theses this instance carries at once. It is a limit on breadth in favour of depth: a run that skims a dozen names and completes none has produced nothing this package can act on or measure. Reaching the limit does not refuse a better candidate — it requires the run to say which existing thesis it is displacing and why.

minimumExecutablePosition.description: An amount of money, in the currency minimumExecutablePositionCurrency names. The smallest position worth opening in that venue: below it, a KOSPI-listed share priced anywhere in the ordinary 10,000-100,000 won range gives a position of a handful of shares, which cannot be staged into or trimmed without changing the weight materially, and whose result is round-trip cost rather than the idea. A weight below this is refused rather than rounded up to it. It becomes a weight as minimumExecutablePosition / book.totalValue, so a run that does not state the size of the account cannot make the comparison and refuses rather than skipping it. It governs ONLY a book denominated in that same currency: on any other the venue minimum for this account is undeclared, the run says so, and no floor constrains it. State minimumExecutableWeight instead to give the floor as a share of the book, which needs no currency at all.

minimumExecutablePositionCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money minimumExecutablePosition is an amount of. KRW because this methodology was written against a Korean venue, and it is a setting rather than a sentence in the prose because a unit that only the prose carries is a unit the arithmetic cannot check: 500,000 divided by a 100,000 dollar book is a floor of 5.0 - five hundred per cent of the account - which no position clears, so the package waited on every book not denominated in won. It is compared against the Mandate's constraints.baseCurrency. An unrecognised code simply compares unequal, which leaves the venue floor undeclared rather than misapplied.

minimumExecutableWeight.description: The same floor as a share of the whole book, and the one spelling of it that needs no currency. There is no default and there is deliberately none: a venue minimum is an amount of money - a share in its ordinary price range, in a quantity that can be staged into and trimmed - and the same statement is 0.1 of a five-million-won account and 0.00001 of a fifty-billion-won one, so no weight could be published here that was not fitted to one account size. Stated, it wins over minimumExecutablePosition outright and nothing about currency is consulted.

riskBudgetWeight.description: Share of the whole book this methodology is willing to lose on ONE idea reaching the price at which its thesis is no longer true; it is the numerator of the position size and never a position size. The pre-registered 0.01 is derived from maxActiveTheses being 6 — a fully committed instance risks 6% of the book if every open thesis invalidates on the same day — and this is the one setting the investor's Mandate has no field for, which is why the package carries it at all. It may only be NARROWED: a larger value is refused, reported, and the pre-registered number governs. Every ceiling the investor did declare still cuts the result.

dividendWithholdingTaxRate.description: The rate the investor's net dividend leg is computed at when the invocation states none. 0.154 is the standard Korean resident withholding rate on dividends including local income tax; an investor taxed otherwise sets their own, and a run that used the default says so, because a total return quoted gross and one quoted net differ by roughly a sixth of the cash leg.
